content: If the foot of the trees were not tied to the earth, of what journeys they would be capable!
author: Rumi
story:
Following the sudden disappearance of his beloved spiritual mentor Shams-i-Tabrizi in 1247, Rumi was plunged into inconsolable grief. Refusing despair, he turned his heartbreak into devotional verse and ecstatic whirling prayer in Konya, discovering that human sorrow breaks open the ego so divine illumination can flood the soul.

This timeless reminder speaks to the universal struggle to balance inner truth with outer demands. Rumi understood that the measure of a meaningful life is not external approval, but the quiet integrity with which we meet each day's encounters.
reflectionPrompt: How can aligning with nature's patient, unhurried timing bring calm to your current situation?
